name: Aircall
verdict: OAuth credentials come only after you sign up as a Technology Partner and email Aircall, and the docs say marketplace listing is required for OAuth. Customer Company Admins install; likely 2-6 weeks, unconfirmed.
needGuide: Yes — sign up as a Technology Partner and request credentials first; nothing works for customers until then.

auth.detail: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code for Technology Partners only: Admin starts from the Aircall Dashboard, your install_uri redirects to dashboard.aircall.io/oauth/authorize (scope=public_api); code valid 10 minutes, exchanged at POST https://api.aircall.io/v1/oauth/token. Access token is described as permanent (refresh not documented). Customers building for their own account use API ID/token Basic auth.

effort.timeToFirstTest: 30-60 min (own account with API key); days after partner approval for OAuth
effort.timeToProduction: unknown (likely 2-6 weeks incl. partner approval and marketplace listing)

approval.gate: Technology partner account plus Aircall issuing OAuth credentials; the docs state listing on the Aircall App Marketplace is a requirement for OAuth. Customers' Company Admins must install.

scopes.why: Only the public_api scope is documented.
scopes.summary: Only public_api is documented. Rate limits and webhook setup apply per company; no scope-level review documented.

prerequisites: Account and owner: Partner contact (company email) completes the partner sign-up; developers need an Aircall account to test.
Where you register: Aircall partner sign-up → request OAuth credentials by emailing marketplace@aircall.io with install_uri and redirect_uri → receive client_id and client_secret

registerAt.path: Aircall partner sign-up → request OAuth credentials by emailing marketplace@aircall.io with install_uri and redirect_uri → receive client_id and client_secret

steps.do: Sign up as a Technology Partner at aircall.io/partners/technology/signup
Email marketplace@aircall.io with app name, HTTPS install_uri and redirect_uri to request client_id and client_secret
Implement install_uri that forwards to dashboard.aircall.io/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code, scope=public_api, state
Implement redirect_uri: exchange the code within 10 minutes at POST https://api.aircall.io/v1/oauth/token
Store the Bearer token per company; call the Public API and register webhooks
Test in Aircall's dashboard with an admin, then agree marketplace listing details with Aircall

roles.team: Partner contact (company email) completes the partner sign-up; developers need an Aircall account to test.
roles.customer: Only Company Admins can authorize the app or install integrations; they click Authorize in the dashboard popup.

testing: Fast path: create an API key in Settings → API Keys → Add a new API key in your own Aircall company and test Basic auth.
For OAuth, a test company or sandbox is not documented: ask Aircall partner team.

blockers.problem: install_uri and redirect_uri must be HTTPS, and install_uri must forward to the authorize URL

blockers.fix: Instruct customers to involve an Aircall Admin.
Provide customer-side revocation and uninstall handling.

automation.agentCan: Write install and redirect handlers, token storage, API calls and webhook consumers; draft the partner application and listing copy.
automation.humanMust: Partner application and agreement, contact with Aircall marketplace team, customer admin consent.

uncertain: Partner approval criteria, sandbox availability, marketplace review steps, fees and timelines (partner pages and developer.aircall.io partner-program URL not loadable); whether refresh tokens exist.
